mapper.sql: r.id AS review_id, r.content, r.images, r.rating_score, r.visited_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, pr_sum.summary AS pr_sum_summary, pr_sum.positive_points AS pr_sum_positive_points, pr_sum.negative_points AS pr_sum_negative_points, pr_sum.recommended_for AS pr_sum_recommended_for, pr_sum.keywords AS pr_sum_keywords, pr_sum.review_count AS pr_sum_review_count, pr_sum.status AS pr_sum_status, pr_sum.last_review_updated_at AS pr_sum_last_review_updated_at, pr_sum.updated_at AS pr_sum_updated_at, p.id AS place_id, p.name AS place_name, p.category_name, p.category_group_code, p.road_address_name, p.x, p.y, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM good_places gp WHERE gp.place_id = p.id AND gp.user_id = #{viewerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS place_is_saved, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.handle AS author_handle, u.profile_image AS author_profile_image, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM follows f WHERE f.target_user_id = u.id AND f.user_id = #{viewerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS author_is_following, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.review_id = r.id ) AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.review_id = r.id ) AS comment_count, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM likes ml WHERE ml.review_id = r.id AND ml.user_id = #{viewerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AS liked_by_me
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( id, content, images, rating_score, visited_at, place_id, user_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{content}, #{images, typeHandler=com.ssafy.gourming.typehandler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{ratingScore}, #{visitedAt}, #{placeId}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, content, images, rating_score, visited_at, place_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM reviews WHERE id = #{reviewId}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id WHERE r.id = #{reviewId}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id WHERE r.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} OR r.user_id IN (SELECT target_user_id FROM follows WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} OR r.user_id IN (SELECT target_user_id FROM follows WHERE user_id = #{userId})

SELECT
FROM popular_review_scores prs JOIN reviews r ON r.id = prs.review_id JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id WHERE prs.window_days = #{windowDays} ORDER BY prs.rank_no ASC, prs.score DESC, r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN place_review_summaries pr_sum ON pr_sum.place_id = r.place_id WHERE p.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.handle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE p.category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.handle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
